resources.string: Only appearance preferences for the current account, organization, deployment, and device are saved. Messages and drafts are not saved, and access permissions do not change.
These sizes affect only chat text and code and are applied on top of the system font size. Buttons and settings still follow the system font size.
This code stores text in a variable, then prints it. Chinese, English, and the digits 0123456789 use the same chat text size. You can adjust the size of the code below separately.
val message = \"Chinese and English preview 0123456789 — a longer line for checking code wrapping\"\nprintln(message)
Turn on to wrap long lines of code, or turn off to scroll horizontally. This does not change or truncate the code.
